subject: maths
question: Two trains, one 125 metres and the other 375 metres long are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks, at the speed of 81 km/hr and 63 km/hr respectively. How much time will they take to cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = Sum of **train lengths** = 125 + 375 = 500 m.

**Relative Speed** (Opposite) = 81 + 63 = 144 km/hr.

Convert Speed to m/s: 144 × (5/18) = 40 m/s.

Required **Time** = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 500 ÷ 40 = 12.5 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.5 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = **125 m**

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = **375 m**

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = **81 km/hr**

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = **63 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12616840660079dc14a0894d15816973c0c6b48b2e62e6cb507b4aada9aa3c0b.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = (L₁ + L₂) ÷ (Relative Speed)

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Length = 125 + 375 = 500 m

⇒ Sum of Speeds = 81 + 63 = 144 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 144 × (5 ÷ 18)

⇒ Relative Speed = 8 × 5 = 40 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 500 ÷ 40

⇒ Time taken = 12.5 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 12.5 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Rules

For two objects moving in the **opposite direction**, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. For **same direction**, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/hr to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert from **m/s to km/hr**, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing Distance

When a train crosses a **pole or point object**, distance = length of the train. When it crosses a **platform or another train**, distance = sum of both lengths.</p
